title: A Spire for the Ember
author: Tamsin Galloway
blurb: Yara Amberdale, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
